title: Knowledge Search System

hero.headline: Search that understands your internal knowledge.
hero.description: A retrieval system designed to make company documents, references, and knowledge bases easier to search and use.

problem: Enterprise knowledge is often fragmented across tools, folders, and teams.
solution: Create a search and retrieval layer that surfaces relevant context with less manual searching and fewer dead ends.
proofNotes: This product should be measured on recall, precision, and usefulness in real workflows.
